title: Create: DDCL
description: Adds dimmable cage lamps for Create: Deco
body:
**Create: Deco Dimmable Cage Lamps (Create: DDCL)**

Have you ever used Create: Deco cage lamps? They are a very good decoration block for your builds. However, i wanted to use them as night safety lamps or as low light level signal lamps in my factories. So i created this mod for doing so.

You can adjust the light level by varying the redstone power input (which you can do with comparators or i also suggest using the sequenced pulse generator from Create: Connected).


## Content

The mod adds the following dimmable lamp version materials in red, blue, green and yellow colors:

- Andesite
- Brass
- Copper (also old create 0.5.1 version)
- Industrial Iron
- Iron
- Zinc
- Gold (not in Create: Deco anymore)
- Netherite (not in Create: Deco anymore)

All the lamps can be obviously used as normal Create: Deco lamps since if you fully power them, their behaviour is the same as normal ones.

The netherite lamps can be crafted with industrial iron ones, i know that this crafting doesn't make sense, but if you want to use the netherite lamps you have to waste one ingot per lamp, and i don't think it's good, so i added this crafting anyway.

The mod also offers two inventory orders for lamps: by-color and by-material, see configs.

I suggest [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) or [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) for the craftings.

## Euphoria Patches Compat

The mod is currently added to [Euphoria Patches](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/), but only works from version 1.0.3 and higher. I removed the old versions since those are deprecated and it was making the euphoria files a big mess.

The colored lights also work with the lower light levels, so you can spice up your builds with shaders!

***

**Starting from version 1.0.1 this mod now requires Create: Deco and Create!**

Important: this mod REUSES some of the deco assets, which should be allowed by [their license.](https://github.com/talrey/CreateDeco?tab=CC0-1.0-1-ov-file)
